next.reason: 1985 only glosses the source-program format's generic terms identification-division, environment-division, data-division, procedure-division and end-program-header. 2023 FMT-10.6.1 keeps environment-division, data-division and procedure-division as meta-terms for the same divisions and writes the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header and the END PROGRAM marker out (end-marker format FMT-10.7.2). Same referents; nothing accepted or refused differs by this rule.
